summary: Engadget's Jeff Dunn rounds up the best headphone, earbud and gaming headset deals on day two of Amazon's October 2023 Prime Big Deal Days sale. Each product gets its sale price, how it compares to past lows or average street prices, and a short verdict drawing on Engadget's review scores and buying guides. Brands covered include Sony, Apple, Beats, Anker, Bose, Sennheiser, Amazon, Shokz, Google, JLab, HyperX and Logitech.
one_line: Engadget's roundup of the best headphone, earbud and gaming headset deals from Amazon's October 2023 Prime Big Deal Days, with prices and review verdicts.
key_facts: The Sony WH-1000XM4 is $248 (from $348), $20 above its all-time low and about $80 below its average street price; Engadget gave it a review score of 94 in 2020.
The Sony WF-1000XM5 earbuds are $278 (from $300), the first discount Engadget has seen for its top wireless earbuds pick; they scored 87.
The Apple AirPods Pro (USB-C) are $189, a new low and $60 off Apple's list price; the Lightning version costs the same, and the AirPods Pro scored 88 last year.
The Beats Studio Pro is $180 (from $350), a new low and a $170 discount; Engadget scored it 81 in July.
The Anker Soundcore Space A40 is $54, matching its all-time low, and is Engadget's top pick for budget wireless earbuds, with up to 10 hours of battery life.
The Bose QuietComfort Earbuds II are $199, an all-time low, though Bose has replaced them with the QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds, which add spatial audio.
The Bose QuietComfort 45 is $229, $30 above its lowest tracked price; Bose recently replaced it with the new QuietComfort Headphones.
The Sennheiser Momentum True Wireless 3 is $142, a new low, and is the runner-up in Engadget's wireless earbuds guide; Billy Steele considers it the best-sounding true wireless pair he has tested.
The Sennheiser HD 560S wired open-back headphones are $150, about $35 below typical street price, and are recommended in Engadget's best gaming headphones guide.
The Amazon Echo Buds (2023) are $35, an all-time low, with an IPX2 rating and about five hours of battery life; they scored 77.
The Google Pixel Buds Pro are $120, a new low and $80 off list price, and are the 'best for Android' pick; they scored 87 last year.
The Shokz OpenRun Pro bone conduction headphones are $125, $25 above the lowest tracked price, with up to 10 hours of battery life.
The JLab Go Air Pop is $16.44, about $6 less than usual, with IPX4 water resistance and about eight hours of battery life.
Gaming headset deals include the HyperX Cloud Stinger 2 at $35, HyperX Cloud Alpha at $60 and Logitech G535 at $80, which does not work with Xbox consoles.
